_README: Copy this file to  Documents\My Games\Fallout4\F4SE\PrismaCraftingRecipes.json  and edit. PrismaCrafting loads it ONCE per session (at save-load / first bench open) and overlays it onto the in-memory recipe index. It only affects PrismaCrafting's own crafting + UI -- no plugin records are touched. Delete the file to fully revert. The plugin already dumps every recipe to  Data\PrismaUI_F4\JsonData\cobj_recipes.json  -- use that as a reference for keys, component ids, and counts.
_KEYS: Each top-level key matches a recipe, tried in order: createdKey ('Plugin.esp|<localFormID hex>') -> COBJ EditorID -> 8-hex runtime COBJ Form ID. createdKey is the most stable across load-order changes.
_IDS: component/condition 'id' forms: 'Plugin.esp|1A2B' (plugin + LOCAL Form ID hex, recommended, stable) | '0001A2B3' (raw 8-hex runtime Form ID, load-order dependent) | 'EditorID' (best-effort, only for components seen in some recipe).
_SEMANTICS: 'components' present => REPLACES the recipe's whole component list. 'conditions' present => REPLACES the craft gate (the engine HasPerk/etc check is skipped and these are evaluated in C++ instead); 'conditions': [] => always unlockable. Omit a key to leave that aspect untouched. Conditions are AND-ed. condition types: perk | global | itemcount | keyword. op: ==  !=  >=  >  <=  <.
